title: haplotype-adqtl: analysis pipeline for cis-haplotype epistasis and ancestry-differential eQTL effects
description: Analysis code and summary-level result tables for the manuscript "Population differences in regulatory haplotype backgrounds explain ancestry-differential eQTL effects". The pipeline identifies ancestry-differential eQTLs in MAGE lymphoblastoid cell lines, tests focal × background cis-haplotype interactions, runs generative simulations, computes haplotype context divergence, and replicates results in Geuvadis.
